title: RVp1: plan review - lane 1
result: REJECT: the plan cannot be executed as written; two checklist items fail. 1) item 5, plan.md:38-39 — Step 3 has `format_greeting` call `greet.greeting(name)`, a name no step in this plan defines (Step 2 defines only `format_greeting` and a `__main__` block), so the first run of the tests raises AttributeError and SC1's Run command can never print `Hello, Ada!`; fix: build the text in `format_greeting` itself, or define the `greeting` helper in the same step's Files block. 2) item 4, plan.md:41-42 — Step 4 creates `config.ini`, which is in no Files block (outside the spec's Scope-in of `greet.py`+`test_greet.py`), and ticks `wc -l < config.ini` prints `0`, a value a file holding a greeting format is never, so the tick no card can honestly make; fix: drop Step 4, or name the file in the Files block and tick on the line it actually prints. VERIFIED: 1 — header has Goal, Architecture, Tech Stack and `Spec: <REFINED>`, Global Constraints present, no "For agentic workers" line and no execution-handoff section; 2 — SC1 is named in Steps 1-3 and SC2 in Step 4, nothing outside Scope-in; 3 — Python (F1) and pytest (F2) are both cited present and the Run commands establish SC1 (the printed line) and SC2 (the pytest totals) as the recipe names them; 6 — no step commits, branches, pushes or stashes, and none carries card mechanics; 7 — every path a step writes is under <WORKDIR> and nothing temporary lands there.
